border_rule: Flag a quadrant if any outer 8-pixel strip has luminance SD <0.025 and its mean differs by >0.08 from the adjacent 8-pixel strip. Aggregate unflagged quadrants; flag all-excluded cases unsupported.
jpeg: Pillow JPEG, subsampling 2; baseline is original release JPEG, NOT Q=100 re-encoding.
resize: Pillow bilinear down/up on the standardized RGB256 canvas
five_crop: Four 128x128 quadrants plus central [64:192,64:192], pooled ordinal counts and median/IQR of five crop measurements
